title: End-to-End Learning for Fair Multiobjective Optimization Under Uncertainty
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and mathematical implementation of fairness in multi-objective optimization using the Ordered Weighted Averaging (OWA) operator. While it discusses fairness properties such as equitability and impartiality, it does so within the framework of algorithmic fairness for decision-making and ranking systems, rather than evaluating religion, theology, or spiritual/moral ethics.
